title: THE IRON LOTUS: THE FALL OF BHISHMA

protagonist.name: Bhishma Pitamaha
protagonist.description: Ancient warrior, golden armor, massive wooden bed of arrows, white beard, half-closed eyes, serene expression

folders.name: Scene 1: The Setting of Desolation
folders.description: The camera establishes the desolate battlefield at sunset. We see the scorched landscape, the air thick with suffocating stillness after chaos. Bhishma is revealed lying upon his bed of arrows, a grotesque monument to his vow. His golden armor hangs loosely on his weakened frame, and his serene yet weary eyes accept the approaching end.

folders.name: Scene 2: Dronacharya's Silent Grief
folders.description: Dronacharya is revealed kneeling nearby in simple grey robes, his staff resting against the earth. His face bears the weight of years and sorrow as tears silently stream down weathered cheeks mixing with battlefield dirt. He watches Bhishma without speaking, honoring the vow of silence that binds him in this final moment together with the dying master.

folders.name: Scene 3: The Final Arrow and Passing
folders.description: Arjuna enters the frame with a heavy heart, approaching Bhishma's bedside to honor his duty to end the conflict. In a moment of profound connection that transcends master-student and warrior-enemy, Arjuna draws the Gandiva bow and releases the final arrow. The arrow strikes with decisive force yet carries no violence—only mercy. Bhishma passes away peacefully, his face returning to complete serenity. The atmosphere transforms instantly from tension into collective mourning as Dronacharya rises, and the war ends.
